question: What is the volume of a right circular cylinder whose curved surface area is 12 π cm² and the circumference of its base is 4 π cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the **radius (r)** from the **circumference**: r = 4π ÷ 2π = 2 cm.

The relationship between **Volume (V)** and **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** is V = (CSA × r) ÷ 2.

Substitute the values: V = (12π × 2) ÷ 2 = 12π cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 12π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of cylinder = 12π cm²

⇒ **Circumference** of the base = 4π cm

**Formulas Used:**

⇒ **Circumference** = 2πr

⇒ **Curved Surface Area** = 2πrh

⇒ **Volume** = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d88d4e2928753e10368aa76621e6610aa7a67dd5f1f687d7c2706441839dbe80.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2πr = 4π

⇒ r = 4π ÷ 2π = 2 cm

⇒ CSA = 2πrh = 12π

⇒ (2πr) × h = 12π

⇒ 4π × h = 12π

⇒ h = 12π ÷ 4π = 3 cm

⇒ **Volume** = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = π × (2)² × 3

⇒ Volume = π × 4 × 3 = 12π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 12π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The sum of curved surface area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume and CSA Relation

The ratio of the volume to the curved surface area of a cylinder is always r ÷ 2.

Area of Base

The area of the circular base of a cylinder is calculated as πr².</p
